lessons: Source foot-band averages are fixed feature definitions, not proven visible painted boot contacts.
Barefoot guide and stylized armored boot volume require a reviewed body-fit and visible point correspondence before numerical contact acceptance.
Do not force paint to a bare-mesh point by deforming limbs or fitting silhouette bounds.
Batch crop/row offsets are another source of registration error and must not be interpreted as motion.
New painting tools have not yet satisfied source-relative anatomy, appearance and temporal constraints.
